limitations: English raw record identities are validated against retained pinned extraction/table files; no fresh replay of the3GB original English archive was executed. Spanish corroborating records were replayed from the exact local gzip.

All English forms use complete unqualified pinned AGID slots. Imperfect English is a selected ongoing animal activity reading, not a universal aspect translation.
